_comment_contact: Used for the Crossref / OpenAlex / Unpaywall polite pool. A real address raises your rate limits noticeably. | 用于 Crossref / OpenAlex / Unpaywall 的 polite pool，填真实邮箱可显著提高配额。

zotero._comment_api_key: Create at https://www.zotero.org/settings/keys with 'Allow library access' + 'Allow write access'. Keep it in config.json only, which is gitignored. | 在该页面生成，勾选读写权限。只写进已被 gitignore 的 config.json。
zotero._comment_local_api: Zotero 7+ exposes a read-only local API (Settings > Advanced). Reads go here; writes go through the Web API. | Zotero 7+ 的本地只读 API，在 设置>高级 开启。读走本地，写走 Web API。
zotero._comment_linked_base: Must equal Zotero > Settings > Advanced > Files and Folders > Linked Attachment Base Directory. PDFs stored here attach as linked files: never uploaded, so they do not consume your Zotero storage quota. | 必须与 Zotero 的「链接附件基准目录」一致。存于此处的 PDF 以链接附件挂载，不上传、不占云端配额。

_comment_s2: Optional. Empty means the anonymous quota (~1 req/s; occasional 429 is handled by exponential backoff). | 可留空，即匿名配额；偶发 429 会自动指数退避。
